# @tansy/newsletter

A newsletter for tansy: subscribers with double opt-in, one-click unsubscribe, and campaigns sent in batches through the site's email, including any post sent as a campaign.

```bash
npm install @tansy/newsletter
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the newsletter plugin documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/plugins/newsletter.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party plugin for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
